title: Query batch run distribution
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Boolean function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, a natural number $m$, and specified inputs $x_1,\ldots,x_m\in\{−1,1\}^n$, running the query batch program returns the labeled sequence $(x_i,f(x_i))_{i=1}^m$ with probability one. Its cost is $(0,m,m)$: no random examples, $m$ queries, and $m$ units of work.
hypotheses_covered: A specified sequence of $m$ cube inputs
